_comment: Keyword monitoring feed register. Queries are written in plain search syntax and turned into feed URLs by scripts/seed-feeds.js. Edit the query here, not the URL. Editions: GB = UK/international edition, NG = Nigerian edition (surfaces local outlets a UK-scoped query silently drops).
